bio: Nestled within the historic charm of Southport, The Grand stands as an alluring testament to time-honoured luxury. Its presence on Lord Street's tree-lined boulevard is more than just a location; it's an invitation to a bygone era of opulence and grandeur. Enjoy five-star excellence in glamorous surroundings that pay tribute to the glitz and glamour of Southport's illustrious past. Delicious cuisine is married together with impeccable service to create an unforgettable experience.  Step into the magnificent Grand Brasserie, where your Afternoon Tea experience truly begins. As a destination in its own right, the Grand Brasserie offers an ambiance that's both sophisticated and inviting. It's here, amidst the grandeur of our historic venue, that you'll embark on a culinary journey like no other.  The Afternoon Tea menu is a celebration of British specialties, featuring delights like Coronation Chicken alongside a mouth-watering selection of pastries to tantalise your taste buds. But at the heart of this experience is the tea itself. Choose from a fabulous array of loose-leaf teas from around the world – from the robust Moroccan Mint to the bold Assam Indian Black Tea or the timeless classic, English Tea. The tea selection is thoughtfully curated to perfectly complement the flavours of your food. If you're looking to add a touch of sparkle to the occasion, consider enhancing your Afternoon Tea with a glass of fizz. And for those with dietary preferences, there is a Vegan & Gluten-Free Afternoon Tea on offer. Bringing along your little cherubs? The Children's Afternoon Tea, a delightful twist on a timeless treat. It's an ideal indulgence for young ones, featuring tasty treats and savoury bites selected with their palates in mind, including mini blueberry muffins, finger sandwiches, and an array of delicious sweet selections. Our afternoon teas are not just a treat; they're a cherished experience for all.
